newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telefonica to fix share offer price Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica to fix share offer price Feb 17.

text.p: Spanish telecoms operator Telefonica de Espana, due to be fully privatised next month, will finalise the share price for its public offer on February 17, sources close to the operation said on Thursday.
The state is selling its remaining 20.9 percent stake in the firm as part of an aggressive drive to raise privatisation earnings.
The sources said Telefonica would guarantee a minimum of 100 shares per retail investor with the remaining shares in that tranche awarded proportionately.

The price for the retail tranche will be the lowest of three options: the high on February 10, a four percent discount on the February 17 reference price, or the institutional sale price which will be set after Wall Street's close on February 17.
Telefonica shares were trading at 3,285 pesetas early on Thursday.
The sources said the company was still discussing the size of the discount and loyalty bonus to be awarded Telefonica employees and pensioners.

Telefonica is planning a big publicity campaign for the offer and hopes to attract small, loyal investors by giving away free trips the Caribbean by lottery and a compact disc for each early subscriber.
The subscription period for the share offer starts January 20 and ends on February 10. Only firm, non-reversible orders can be made between then and February 14.
The sale comes amid other European telecom company share offers, but analysts say Telefonica's growth potential in Spain and Latin America make it attractive.
